messages:
laura: Quick triage — vendor slotting conflict flagged for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi wave. Press window overlaps SI launch and marketplace cutover. Can partners decouple embargo windows? Need ETA by EOD. TL;DR: risk to marketplace launch.

mike: Do we have concrete ship dates from each vendor? Trying to map to marketplace release lanes.

sanju: Got a note from Nvidia this morning — H200 supply slipping ~2 weeks vs original plan. H100 still on baseline. MI300 (AMD) shipping targets unchanged. Gaudi (Habana) says no changes but small binning variance.

elaine: @nvidia_bot can you drop the embargo windows matrix we agreed with press/comms? Need exact ranges to communicate to partners.

nvidia_bot: Embargo windows (shared doc): NVIDIA H100: 2026-06-10 — 2026-06-16; NVIDIA H200: 2026-06-17 — 2026-06-23 (tentative, subject to supply); AMD MI300: 2026-06-12 — 2026-06-18; Habana Gaudi: 2026-06-14 — 2026-06-20. See https://tinyurl.com/redwood-embargo-matrix :mag:

ashley: Ops question — if H200 slips, can we fallback to B200 instances in the marketplace? B200 perf/cost is different and SI bundles may need SKU updates.

sanju: B200 is an option but inventory is limited for ~2 weeks after the slip window. We'd need gating flags on the marketplace and an SKU mapping table. I can prepare a short runbook.

laura: Good. Action items: 1) @mike own marketplace gating PR + SKU mapping 2) @sanju draft fallback runbook + inventory check 3) @elaine coordinate press comms edits if windows change. If vendors can't decouple embargo windows, we shift joint announce to next wave.

mike: On it — creating PR now, will include feature flag and SKU mapping. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/pulls/4321 (WIP).

elaine: I sent a 10:30 PT invite to vendor leads + comms. Short sync to confirm final embargo ranges and decide go/no-go for joint announcement.

laura: If we don't have signoff by 18:00 PT today escalate to sales + comms. Also adding a fallback note in the release playbook: prefer H100 first, H200 fallback only if confirmed stock, B200 as last-resort with clear perf/cost caveat. :warning:

ashley: ack — I'll update the SI partner-facing docs with perf caveat blurb.

sanju: I'll post inventory snapshot right after the 10:30 sync.

mike: PR created, tagging @sanju @elaine for review.

laura: thanks team. quick wins: keep partner liaison in loop, update marketplace gating by EOD, and prepare public-facing comms only after final signoff. :thumbsup:

nvidia_bot: Reminder: vendor embargo handshake checklist due before joint announce. Checklist template: ```- embargo range confirmed
- press brief approved
- SI launch dependencies validated
- marketplace SKU gating ready```

laura: End of thread — will post a status update after the sync.
